content.H2_rule: per pair, after it completes, in the order (1x, 0.5), (1x, 2.0), (2x, 0.5), (2x, 2.0): |margin - baseline margin at that price| <= the baseline pair threshold at that price and the verdict (and its sign) unchanged; a failed pair does not stop E2 (Addendum 86 ruling 3 (i))
content.margin_definition: margin = Q(x = 0) - Q(unit) - I(unit) within each pair (plan section 4, clarification 3)
content.objective_convention: Q = certified gross_operational_cost, contracted interface settlement EXCLUDED (Addendum 83 ruling 2); salvage reported separately; net = gross - terminal salvage
content.rho_read_back_rule: Addendum 86 ruling 2: per E2 cell, per cycle, per channel g in {v, pf, ess}, the recorded rho_g_after equals BITWISE sum([x] * n_g) / n_g in the canonical interpreter; x starts at S39_g x s and is carried across cycles from the recorded actions: increased -> x = min(max(x * 1.5, 1e-4), 1e4); decreased -> x = min(max(x * (1.0 / 1.5), 1e-4), 1e4) (production _scale_admm_penalty: value * factor, factor = 1.0 / decrease_factor); every factor-1 action (held, fixed, exempt (fixed), held after solver failure, held (frozen ...), any of them with " (exemption lifted)") keeps x; an unknown action refuses; n_v = n_pf = TSO + DSO blocks, n_ess = TSO + DSO + ESSO models (the record's solve_profile). A cell that does not reproduce bitwise is a harness-fault stop.
content.stage: P5.15 Addendum 86 ruling 1, W183i (b) -- the Step-7 fixed-plan launcher: E3 (C_NRF), E2 stage 1 (rho0 x s), the 1x unit-neighbourhood screen, the cross-evaluations (declared after W186)
content.verdict_rule: rule v6: determinate iff both certified and |margin| >= max{3 x the larger band, 2 tau}, tau = settling_criterion_v6.TAU = 4539.0682750000005; otherwise the uncertified form

H3c.matching: (node, year, day, period): the capture's binding_hours "hour" is the period index of _get_interface_reporting_detail (0-based), Z7's "period" the same index

cell_report.objective_convention: Q = certified gross_operational_cost, contracted interface settlement EXCLUDED (Addendum 83 ruling 2); salvage reported separately; net = gross - terminal salvage
cell_report.stopping_ratio_definition: rule ten: |Q[k] - Q[k-1]| / objective_tolerance at the last cycle (the record's rule_ten.terminal_step_over_threshold)

decomposition.convention: Q = gross, settlement excluded; TN = the sum over the 12 TSO blocks of the block gross (weighted); DN = the 36 DSO blocks; TN conventional = TSO generation_cost; DN flexibility = DSO flexibility_cost_internal; for Q(P_NRF) the TN term is the arm's TSO block_components and the DN term the residual (the W124 method, Table 12 / Fig. 5(b))
decomposition.curtailment_definition: P_NRF: the Table 12 / E.23 column (report_v3 curtailment_table phase A, by agent, mwh_day_weighted / 1000). C_NRF / C_OPEN: the record's res_curtailment_definitional_at_weight_1 (component levels, unweighted per representative day, signed) x the instance day weight (read from the price-taker arm's per-block day_weight) / 1000 -- the coordinated cells' measure; its equivalence with the phase-A curtailment definition is NOT confirmed (Table 12 reports dashes for the coordinated row)

H3b_90p9_pm_0p1_MEUR_and_12p2_percent.statement: H3b: Q(P_NRF) - Q(C_NRF) = 90.9 M EUR +- 0.1 M EUR, 12.2 % at one decimal

difference_1.admm_cell_measure_definition: max(the C_NRF certification band (or the harness bar if uncertified), the between-configuration spread of Q at C* = claim.bands_eur.coordinated_reproducibility_0.011pct)
difference_1.definition: Q(P_NRF) - Q(C_NRF), relative to Q(P_NRF) (coordination under NRF)
difference_1.rule: plan section 3 (clarification 5): resolved only if it exceeds three times each of the two measures; the two are reported side by side, never combined; "determinate" is reserved for ADMM pairs under rule v6

H3a_positive_and_within_resolution_lt_2t.statement: H3a: Q(C_NRF) - Q(C_OPEN) is positive and within resolution (< 2 tau = 9.1 k EUR)
